title: Global consensus on keratoconus and ectatic diseases
text: Keratoconus assessment should integrate corneal shape, posterior surface and pachymetric distribution rather than rely on a single measurement. Progression requires change over time and specialist clinical correlation.

title: Multimodal diagnostics for keratoconus and ectatic corneal diseases
text: Screening and diagnosis benefit from multimodal evaluation that combines corneal tomography, thickness distribution, elevation, curvature and, where available, biomechanical information. Individual indices should be interpreted in context.

title: Repeatability and agreement between corneal imaging devices
text: Keratometry and pachymetry measurements can differ across imaging technologies. Serial monitoring is most interpretable when acquisition quality and device consistency are considered.

title: KERALINK randomized controlled trial
text: In young patients with progressive keratoconus, corneal cross-linking reduced progression compared with standard care. A screening result alone does not establish progression or treatment eligibility.

title: Keratoconus treatment algorithm
citation: Andreanos et al., Ophthalmology and Therapy, 2017
text: Management depends on progression, visual function, corneal characteristics and patient needs. Options for visual rehabilitation and disease stabilization serve different purposes and require specialist assessment.
